notes.title: Patch Notes | Build 0.8.8.18
notes.notes: [p]Hello high rollers![/p][p][/p][p]Today's update brings some small visual changes and bug fixes. You can find them below.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Changes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]BUILD NUMBER[/b]: Build number will now be changed to the current version AND the date of release. I'm updating often enough an incremental change is just silly. So the current build is version 0.8 with changes made 8.18 (August 8th). So, 0.8.8.18![/p][/*][*][p][b]Point tally[/b] now has higher increments with bigger space between them, as to avoid 4 minute tallies ([i]Sorry for the player that suffered that one![/i]). Tallying up points should go a lot faster now with giant scores. A new [b]larger point tally graphic has been added[/b] so see if you can catch it![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Cooldowns[/b] for hands and items have gotten a visual rework as shown below:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353088/c45d85de1d891a36e3c980bd500e6d27faf6978d.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]A more [b]general yellow/pink/blue theming[/b] is being worked into other parts of the game, starting with text boxes. Keep an eye out![/p][/*][*][p][b]Math icon[/b] has been changed to a calculator. After I thought about it, a calculator just added up better than a whiteboard.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Text has been reworked[/b] for a few descriptions. [b]Current Points[/b] and [b]Target Points[/b] have been renamed [b]POINTS[/b] and [b]TARGET[/b] to make things simpler.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Trash[/b] hand is now labeled as "unsaleable" when trying to sell in the shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Pop up bubbles could overlap the ROLL button, causing accidental misclicks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gold Coin[/b] just didn't work, and now correctly rolls the highest face value.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]... and more to come! This is just the start of an update, but wanted to roll it out since it contained some important bug fixes. The next update will feature tweaked boss rounds to make things more fair going forward. Look for that [b]before the end of August[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Kind regards,[/p][p]sofamire[/p]

notes.title: Roadmap to Release!
notes.notes: [h3]Hello high rollers![/h3][p][/p][p]Thank you all for checking [b]Diecast[/b] out as part of the [b]Tiny Teams Festival[/b]! I appreciate all the feedback and reviews I've received so far, and I am reading them all and taking notes on how to improve the game.[/p][p][/p][p]As Tiny Teams is nearing its end, I wanted to share a rough roadmap of what to expect in 2025 leading up to release in 2026. You can find the roadmap below.[/p][p][/p][h1]Diecast (Tentative) Roadmap to Release[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353088/3f8ea4a964c1995917af46062b3f3c3a2baff256.png"][/img][/p][h2]Late August:[/h2][h3]Quality of Life[/h3][p]This update will bring some bug fixes, as well as time spent making sure all text for hands, dice, and pins is consistent across the board. Hands will also get a slight rework with how cooldown and expanded info is displayed.[/p][p]Finally, I've received feedback about full-stop bosses, which I agree are annoying when they end a run without warning. I don't want to go the reroll route, as I feel that can be an easy out as a developer. While rerolling bosses may end up being an option, I'm planning to take a different route.[/p][p]Certain bosses (looking at you Hoarder, Mountain, and Molehill) will become minibosses of a sort at Sectors 4 and 6. These will become [b]"Dual Duel" sectors[/b], where you are given a [b]choice of two bosses with opposite but similar strategies[/b]. Mountain (only dice valued 4 and higher can be scored) and Molehill (only dice valued 4 and lower can be scored) will become paired at the top, and you will get to choose which to face. Hoarder (you must play five dice) will get a new paired boss Pincher (you must play four or less dice).[/p][p]More paired bosses will be planned for future updates, to help spread out the boss pool for multiple runs.[/p][p][/p][h2]October:[/h2][h3]Beta Test[/h3][p]This update will be a [b]private beta[/b] through Steam, with some major reworks to the design of the game. This will be fairly open, and shared through Discord or other channels. This update will focus on adding a base for more variety and content, that will be expanded in future updates.[/p][p][b]Alternate Shops[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Alternate shops will be added[/b], and provide more options for crafting a specific build. Examples include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Whoops All Dice[/b]: Extra dice appear in the shop.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pin Trader[/b]: Extra pins appear in the shop.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Farmer's Market[/b]: Only fruit dice appear in the shop.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Math Class[/b]: Only number dice appear in the shop.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Dice Classes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Dice classes will be introduced, leading to only certain dice appearing in shops[/b]. This will also be used later to affect scoring hands or pins in future updates.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Dice, Scoring Hands, Bosses, etc.[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]More content will be added to increase build variety[/b], and help fill out shops (Farmer's Market). Unique scoring hands will be added to further increase variety, and more bosses will be added with different twists (Gambler, Void).[/p][/*][/list][h2]November:[/h2][h3]Core Engine Work[/h3][p]This update will (finally) introduce a [b]save/load system[/b], [b]unlockables[/b], and [b]groundwork for future language localization[/b]. This will be a lot of deep system work that won't be pretty for sharing (but I probably still will over on Bluesky). [b]Dice, pins, and scoring hands will be locked with this update[/b], to help with initial runs not feeling overwhelming. These will be unlocked through completing specific in-game achievements. Language localization will be coming (eventually) hopefully for release. If not, my plan is to add more languages ASAP after release. Which leads to...[/p][h2]2026:[/h2][h3]Release![/h3][p]My plan is for Diecast to [b]release in early 2026[/b]. I'm working on Diecast in my free time as a solo hobby project, so the release may change depending on life events, time available, etc. There's no set deadline for me, and no rush to complete the game. I'd rather release Diecast when it is ready, than rush to finish it by a certain date.[/p][p][/p][p]That's it! Thank you all for checking out Diecast during the Tiny Teams Festival! Thank you for the feedback, bug reports, and especially Steam reviews. I'm taking all the feedback to heart to make this game into something special.[/p][p][/p][p]Kind regards,[/p][p]sofamire[/p]

notes.title: Diecast is part of Tiny Teams Fest!
notes.notes: [h3]Hello, high rollers![/h3][p][/p][p]I’m excited to announce that [b]Diecast[/b] is a part of [b]Tiny Teams[/b], celebrating unique indie titles that are recently released or coming soon![/p][p][/p][p]A bit about my game: Diecast is a roguelike take on Yahtzee, and with over 30 dice and 30 items (so far) with combos and synergies that can get kinda crazy. Look forward to updates and changes to the demo almost every week till release in early 2026. Check out the demo and leave a review to let me know what you think! If you have any ideas or suggestions, you can leave feedback from the in-game link in the options menu. Together, we can make Diecast something special![/p][p][/p][p]Besides my game, there are a LOT of other really cool indie gems, so go play some of them below:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2958140/NETCRAWL/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399130/Dominova/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3284290/Moonsigil_Atlas/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2985450/Umigame/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3495250/Glory_On_Pluto/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3059510/Bean_Beasts_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3509230/Gambonanza/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2420800/Sol_Mates/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Enjoy playing![/h3]

notes.title: Demo Release - Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]Welcome high rollers![/p][p][/p][p]The demo has been out for almost two weeks, and I've been working away daily to add new content and requested features to prepare for Tiny Teams 2025! Here is a comprehensive list of what has been changed or added over the past two weeks.[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy playing! I look forward to reading your reviews and your ideas on what to work on next :)[/p][p][/p][h2]0.8.5.633 Patch Notes[/h2][h3][b]General:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New interactive tutorial to better teach the flow of the game. Added a tutorial option that is always available and no longer mandatory.[/p][/*][*][p]New pop up effects for dice that are smaller and more readable, showing which die did what.[/p][/*][*][p]Press ESC key to bring up options menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added resolution and window settings to the options menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new font options [i](player request)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]New visuals and music for "game over" and “victory” screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "endless" mode option upon beating a run.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Dice, Hands, Items, and Bosses:[/b][/h3][p][b]New Dice:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Investment[/b] (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)[/p][list][*][p]When scored, increase interest earned by 2%[/p][/*][*][p]This should help improve the rate at which money is earned for now. More to come in future updates![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Dice Buffs:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Banana Stand[/b] lowest value faces changed from 0 to 1 allowing it to be scored.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Grape Harvest[/b] gains greater stacks now equal to face value.[/p][list][*][p]1/2 face value → full face value[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Banana Grab[/b] gains greater stacks now equal to face value.[/p][list][*][p]1 stack → full face value[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Piggy Bank[/b] now has an additional face that can increase sell value to earn money faster.[/p][list][*][p]1, 2, 3 → 1, 2, 3, 4[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Dice Nerfs:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Crystal Dice[/b] now equally add 10% of the target points to points when popped.[/p][list][*][p]15%, 30%, 50% → 10%[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple players let me know that Crystal Dice were way too overpowered. This should help keep them useful when you have a lot at once, but make single dice less powerful.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Other Dice Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New visuals for [b]Banana Stand[/b][/p][/*][*][p]New visuals for [b]Banana Grab[/b][/p][/*][*][p]New visuals for [b]Grape Harvest[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Hand Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Trash[/b] scoring hand can always be made, even when no dice are able to be selected. [/p][list][*][p]Removed POINTS on upgrade, and reduced MULT to make it less spammy.[/p][/*][*][p]10(+5) x 0.5(+0.25) → 10(+0) x 0.5(+0.1)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Rebalanced POINT and MULT level up values to create a smoother difficulty curve across the board.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Item Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Crystalmancer’s Robe[/b] chance of spawning a crystal die reduced.[/p][list][*][p]This goes along with reducing how often [b]Crystal Dice[/b] can steamroll the target points.[/p][/*][*][p]1 in 3 chance → 1 in 5 chance[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]New Boss Targets:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Jester[/b] - one less reroll on each hand played[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hoarder[/b] - Hands must be made of five dice[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leech[/b] - Steals 20% of the score[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mountain[/b] - Only dice valued four or higher count in scoring[/p][/*][*][p][b]Molehill[/b] - Only dice values four or lower count in scoring[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Shop Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reworked dice and item rarity odds in the shop to better align rarities with how often they appear.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked shop randomization to prevent duplicates on rerolling.[/p][/*][*][p]Items have been renamed to “pins” and had their visuals reworked to better distinguish them from dice.[/p][/*][*][p]Scoring options have been renamed to “hands”. An identifier has been added to show when you are rolling or scoring.[/p][/*][*][p]Price of scoring hands in shop reduced to help with leveling up new or weaker ones.[/p][list][*][p]$6 → $4[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Visuals[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reworked game logo[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed “Toggle Values” to “Show Values” to better convey its use[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked “level complete”[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked text, color, placement, and size for a few UI elements[/p][/*][*][p]New expanded info popup for dice and scores[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked Sector 8+ background[/p][/*][*][p]Rework die rarity colors (dice and items)[/p][list][*][p]Gray (common) → Green (uncommon) → Blue (rare)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reworked shop theme[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Audio[/h3][list][*][p]Added main menu and victory music by Elektrobear[/p][/*][*][p]Did another pass to in-run music, adding more details[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]There are many other small changes not listed. Thank you to everyone who has provided feedback so far, or left a review! I am reading everything, so please let me know if you have any ideas or suggestions. I'll be bug fixing and tweaking for the next week or so. Then, keep an eye out for a larger update adding a new die class. It'll be worth your time (or money...)[/p][p][/p][p]Till next time,[/p][p]sofamire[/p][p][/p][p][/p]
